command: set -eo pipefail; export HF_TOKEN="$(cat "$MEGATOKEN_CW_SECRETS/hf-token")"; mkdir -p /work/out/prepared /work/scratch; megatoken codec --output /work/codec | tee /work/out/prepared/codec.json; pids=(); for i in $(seq 0 $((LATER_SHARDS-1))); do python scripts/scale_source_caps.py configs/data/sources.later-stages.json /work/scratch/sources.later-$i.json --scale "$LATER_ROW_SCALE" --shard "$i/$LATER_SHARDS" | tee -a /work/out/prepared/shards.log; megatoken prepare --sources /work/scratch/sources.later-$i.json --output /work/out/prepared/later-$i --codec /work/codec --parser-review-config configs/data/parser-review.agentic.json --reject-invalid > /work/out/prepared/later-$i.log 2>&1 & pids+=($!); done; failed=0; for i in $(seq 0 $((LATER_SHARDS-1))); do wait ${pids[$i]} || true; grep -q '"complete": true' /work/out/prepared/later-$i/manifest.json || { echo "shard $i did not finish"; tail -5 /work/out/prepared/later-$i.log; failed=1; }; done; exit $failed
